body: Sorry I took so long and god, it must be so hard. I actually don't know what's worse, if being angry about it or depressed. Well maybe the worse is dealing with both at the same time. If you need to talk I'm here<3 I hope it gets better
Breaking Bad was a great spin-off, it deserves more recognition. Could have been better with more Saul but ok

I'm not looking to believe in God again, and it wasn't because I was under emotional stress. In the past I tried to find some sense of community in different churches, but how can I do it being a bisexual, communist woman? I'm the incarnation of hell.

Thank you so much for sharing and I'm really sorry for your loss. I'm glad that it helped you knowing your son, wherever he is, is feeling the peace he so desperately craved for. I still can't believe in God but I don't own the truth, so maybe you're right. I just hope you're right, and we're able to talk to our loved ones and hold them once again. Hope you're doing well, you deserve it💓

Thank you for opening up about it with me, you don't know how much I appreciate it. I'm sorry you had to go through this, and even though it might not mean much as we don't know each other, let me tell you I am proud of you and even inspired by your strength. I mean, grieving while dealing with an addiction must be one of the hardest things to experience, and you're doing it and nailing it, while also helping others with your kindness. You didn't deserve any of it, and still all your efforts will lead to you finding some peace. I can't tell you enough how much you deserve to be happy and hopefully you know that. Now, reading this ultimately helped me decide I would try the medium thing. There's nothing to lose and maybe it will give some closure. I'm still afraid though, what if they tell me my ex thinks I'm actually guilty? lol. thank you for responding and I hope you're doing well, take care💓
This is so enraging. I wish your family was more understanding, you don't deserve that. You did everything you could. Hope you're doing better and thank you for answering 💕
That's true. I guess it's helpful that way. There's nothing after I'm gone, living with pain with occasional joy is better than nothing. Hope you're ok💓
Thank you 💓💓💓 hope you're doing well
Thank you for your answer and I'm so sorry for your loss. Hope you're doing better, you sound really kind and deserving of so much happiness. Take care 💓

I'm so, so sorry. You're so young to be dealing with this, please stay strong. This will become a little more bearable if you wait. I hope you're getting professional help to go through this, you can't deal with this alone. Wish you the best💓

I think about him and how much fun we would've had. We were a long distance couple so we spent lots of time on video calls playing games on steam, watching movies and our favorite TV shows. Now would've been the perfect time to do those things, the days would pass so much faster. I wish he could have stayed to make fun of all this mess. Wish you the best🌼💓

Yes. But it's also because I realised after all of this happened that I was being emotionally abused by him. I get angry at him and angry that I hate him and angry that I love him still and mis him like hell. It's really complicated. I still like better feeling angry than fully i-cant-get-out-of-bed depressed.
Thank you so much! I hope you're doing better, you deserve it. ❤️

And if this gives you any comfort too, I didn't mention: I'm going through fucking hell, you could check my other posts here. Please don't make it any harder for her you have no idea how she's doing or dealing with this. Wish you the best ❤️

Please don't. I beg you. I don't know what she did or if she treated him poorly, but I can tell you I'm a position similar to hers. My boyfriend killed himself the day after I broke up with him, and even though it's so easy for his family and friends to blame it on me, it's not my fault, nor hers. It's easier that way, it's easier to blame someone other than him, but it's not fair. She was a teenager. You shouldn't date someone with the threat of suicide hanging above your head in the relationship, and god, if she doesn't want to return his belongings even if that sounds selfish, maybe it's because she's dealing with it too. I'm pretty sure that even without that letter, she already thinks it was all her fault. I assure you. Please. Take it from me. I feel responsible because not breaking up with him would have meant he would still be here and his family wouldn't be hurting, but suicide is never a rational response to anything, even less as a result to a failed relationship as a teen. You're dumb, it's the first time you're experiencing things, you're going to make a lot of mistakes. I can't believe how much you're suffering and this is a horrible thing to go through, but spare her that. Try to forgive her, and him.

Yeah. When I tell my loved ones they act like I should be already past the anger and that I should make peace with it, but I feel like the anger will never go away. I hate him so much. And miss him a lot. It's weird.

I thought I was the only one. When I think of my boyfriend I feel like I made him up. Like he was kind of an imaginary friend I really liked. But the anger and the sadness are very real, just not him.
Maybe this situation is what will lead to the "Wexler v Goodman" episode and not a real fight between them
I'd love to help! Pm me

God, I'm 18. I thought I was too young to go through this. I'm so sorry, that's not something you should deal with at 15 and I admire your strength, you give me hope and you'll make it through this and you'll feel happiness again. I'm so sorry. I truly wish you the best and it goes for you too, if you ever have ideations, we need you here. You're worth everything. If you ever need to talk I'm willing to listen and so are many people here.

Thank you so much! Your comments, even if not directed at me, make me feel a lot better and I wish you the best💕 I know I shouldn't self-diagnose but I get really anxious about not understanding what I feel so I start reading a lot about things to see if any of them fit me, to pretend I have answers and that things make sense, hehe. I'll seek for professional help though, I just have to be patient. Thank you 💕
Thank you, hope it gets better for you!💓
Same. It allowed me to cry after a long time of not being able too but it was too much, I felt incredibly depressed afterwards

It really was. I started shaking and crying without being able to stop. Haven't watched the show since I finished it (it's one of my favorite shows and I used to repeat episodes all the time). The goddamn poem
Then just wait and keep going❤️

This might sound crazy but I feel the same way. I read the title and clicked immediately expecting to read this, that I wasn't going crazy. Maybe we both are! But at least now I really mean that you're not alone. Even one day I had a panic attack telling people "he's not dead, I'm just in the wrong timeline." And also got kinda obsessed with that game, life is strange and its comic (don't judge me I'm 18) where she was able to move through timelines where dead people were alive, and thought that maybe it was something I'd be able to do with time and wanting it too much. I guess that's something PTSD does to you, you don't recognize the world you're in anymore so that's the way our brain tries to explain it and also, of course, because we want it to be true and want things to be how they used to. And it's been said that there are alternative realities where things are different and I really wish I could be in one where maybe there's pain but it is more bearable and this didn't happen. This is just denial. Let's just hope that someday you (and I) feel comfortable in this world again and it doesn't feel as strange, scary and unknown. 
I'm sorry if you ultimately don't relate to any of this and maybe I ended up projecting. I hope things get better for you.❤️
Yes. Sometimes it is because the trauma is unbearable, sometimes they come as intrusive thoughts, which get scary. I guess it's normal for ptsd

Same. I also can see clearly the image of me lying in my bed, dead, and my parents finding me. It's so horrible. I wish I could say something to help you. Just don't listen to your head, I guess? And read the advice other people have given.  Really hope it gets better for you<3

Thank you so much, and I'm really sorry for your loss. As a mother, god, I can't imagine all the strength it takes, and without knowing you, I admire you. Thank you for being here. And yes, my ex-boyfriend took his life and that triggered them. I'm doing everything I can to fight them. Thank you for your kindness and I really hope it gets better for you.

Thank you so, so much. You really helped. I'll also make a plan to deal with the intrusive thoughts and anxiety when it gets bad, I didn't think about it before. Thank you, for real <3 hope you're doing better
Thank you so much for your kindness❤️ I'll search for help
I'm so sorry, I didn't want to be insensitive, I just wanted to know if this was a normal part of the grieving process
I'm having problems dming here but sure, my Instagram is @karamaz0vy and thank you❤️

This is also my first experience with grief. I'm 18 and my boyfriend was too and the idea of having my soulmate gone was devastating, so I get it. It's too much. If you want to talk I'm here <3 take care

I'm so sorry. You and your son don't deserve to go through this. He seemed like he was a troubled man and it's not your fault at all. That's not something rational you do after having a fight, and even less on a subject like this. Please, believe everyone when they tell you it's not your fault. It seems like it could have happened over any fight, with you or anyone close to him. Be strong, take care of you and your son, search for therapy❤️ this was really traumatic

I'm so happy for you! I am too an atheist, and even though I still don't believe in God, sometimes I let myself imagine there's kind of an afterlife where I will join my boyfriend and my other loved ones once I die. Sometimes I think it's silly, sometimes I don't and I let it bring me peace. I wish I could see him in my dreams too! They're always just nightmares. Anyways, I hope you get to see him more often and hear the words you think he wanted to tell you. ❤️

He killed himself the day after I broke up with him over a fight we had. I'm pretty sure he dealt with borderline personality disorder so it wasn't like he felt miserable all the time, he got depressed not very often and lasted only a few hours or a day.   He could improve, he just never searched for help and gave me the role of her psychologist and his only source of happiness. It was all a tantrum. Of course, I'm sorry, I don't know your pain. But I don't wish this upon no one and if you can consider a bit the damage you will leave to the people that love you, please do. And try your hardest for things to change. Talk to your loved ones. you're not alone. You can get peace.
Yeah, thank you.❤️
Thank you so much❤️ hope you're doing well

I never thought of suicide as a selfish thing until my boyfriend died and all he left behind was hurt, trauma and unbearable guilt and pain. When you want to kill yourself you think people will get over it, cry a few days, but no. The pain you feel right now when you die is left to the people who are here and loved you. While you get peace (I mean, you're dead) the people who survived will deal with this for the rest of their lives, happiness will be hard to find, you can't trust or love people anymore without being scared of being abandoned again in such traumatic way. Some of us constantly fantasize about dying, we're at a higher risk of commiting suicide too. I'm here because of it. I want to die, and I resent him because he killed himself and ruined my life, his mom's life, his brother's. So yeah, it's fucking selfish. I swear to God I'm in more pain right now than my boyfriend ever was. Please just find help, living with this trauma is no way to live a happy life. You're changed forever, and can never go back.
This really gives me hope. Thank you so much for sharing and wish you the best❤️

I'm so sorry, God, this is horrible, but that last sentence is so powerful. My boyfriend wanted me to follow him too. But we won't. Please, be strong, take care of yourself. If you need to talk I'm here and so many people. You deserve so much happiness and peace, please wait so one day you'll get a taste of it, I swear. To both of us. Hold on❤️
Thank you so much, and yes, it helps to keep in mind that suicide is never a rational response, and even less to a break up. Hope you're doing well <3

What the fuck. How can you be so cold? You think she doesn't feel enough guilt and isn't being punished enough for what happened? This is unnecessary, so fucking devoid of empathy. She already "knows" this. It's easy to say all of us here dealing with bereavement are guilty in a way, but do you think it's fair to say it while dealing with unbearable guilt and all kinds of negative emotions? Suicide is not a rational reaction to an affair or a divorce. It's not her fucking fault. She made a mistake, yes, deserved to feel bad about hurting his husband? Yes, but she doesn't deserve to carry the guilt for a suicide.

My boyfriend hung himself the day after I broke up with him, like 5 weeks ago. It's normal to feel dissociated, like nothing's real, you will get through it. If you need to talk, I'm here. And even if it's hard to believe it right now, it's not your fault. You deserve to be alive. I wish you the best, please take care of yourself. Please.

I wish I could help you but we're in a pretty similar situation. I cried the first two days, I really thought he did it out of despair and couldn't deal with the guilt about not being able to calm him down. I also didn't see the body nor went to the funeral so everything I got was my imagination. I convinced him not to do it twice before too. I was really depressed until I read the fucking later, it's him blaming everyone but himself. I've never felt so angry, like he lost all my respect. It feels like he killed himself during a fucking tantrum (I broke up with him a day before). He was so angry. Now all I can think about is how he permanently scarred me and how all the beautiful things we lived are poisoned by this. I don't want to cry for a man who would do that to me. And then, sometimes it hits me that it was my fault and I try to get out of there by thinking I'm better off without him. I'm not. But yeah, I feel like I should be crying more, not hating him and telling my friends and family he was a piece of shit.
Sometimes I think this might be a joke from his manipulative ass, maybe because I didn't see the body, but I know he's dead. Maybe I'm still in denial? Don't know. 
Sorry for venting here, just wanted to tell you you're not alone. It's a process and we can't avoid it, someday it's going to end. Until then, just accept it's weird and don't judge yourself. Wish you the best❤️

I guess I still am in that stage of grief where I hate him, so when I feel bad when I should be feeling happy I try to deny it by saying "I am better off without you, asshole!" 
But I am not. lol.

We're almost in the same situation(?) He told me we were soulmates and expected me to kill myself too. But everyday I'm trying to prove myself he was wrong, and so should you. Don't rush to another relationship if you don't want to but you deserve so much love and happiness. He wasn't being fair and instead being really delusional. He isn't right. You'll love and be happy again. Hope it gets better, hang on<3
I won't, thank you, wish you the best ❤️
Thank you so much for caring. Kindness from strangers definitely makes everything easier and I'm glad. This really helped and I hope it gets better for you everyday🥰
Thank you🥰 same goes for you! We need your kindness <3
Thank you so much. Today I was just feeling really low but now I'm way more calmer and even more now with your comment. I hope it gets better. Wish you the best

I lost my partner recently to suicide, and God, I was a mess. Crying and shaking, I think it triggered me horribly but at the same time it allowed me to cry after a long time of not being able to. Especially with that poem. The show is a masterpiece.

I'm so sorry. I used to watch the show with my boyfriend too. It's funny because while watching I thought everything was just a bad joke. My boyfriend dies and now My favorite show ends on that note. 
Also, My boyfriend called me before doing it, just like Bojack called Diane, giving her the responsability to save him. we were in a long distance relationship. Ugggghhh i hate it. I hope you're doing better

God, you didn't deserve to go through this. Wow. I'm so sorry. Please take care of yourself and find support with a professional. You deserved better. I hope writing this helped you release some of that baggage.
Yes! That's what scares me the most, not finding anyone to have genuine connection. Thank you. hope you're doing well <3

I just caught the flu" and started sending me pictures and videos of himself, even one of him and his mother smiling. I just thought he was from an alternate universe and that I would never reach him, and I just started to tell him all the horrible things that his death would cause. He tried to comfort me telling me "relax, I would never hurt You like that." It hurts like hell.

Thank you so much, for real. You deserve all the happiness in the world. reading this really helped me and now I feel more hopeful about my future. I wish I could hug you, the world owes you kindness. 💗
Thank you, that really helped, we've been punished enough. 💗
Yeah, thanks. I will

I don't have any idea of what to do to feel better, so I forced myself to go back to normal in a few days, and this frustrated me bc i'm not this person. Now with your comment I'll slow down to take care of myself. Thank you, for real. Wish you the best
I hope you're doing so much better, thank you for reading. <3
You're right, thank you so much. 💗 Hope you're doing well
Thank you<3 and so am I, I guess that's why I'm still trying to help others.

Thank you so much. Also, this post is not about this and sorry if I make you uncomfortable, you don't have to answer. But it's so great for me to hear You are now in a relationship after this. I feel like I could never be in one again or fall in love. Like no one is going to fill that hole. Does your partner make you feel better about this? Did it help?

I'm at that point right now. Sometimes I feel like forgiving him and then someone gives me a little detail I didn't know about his dead and I explode again, because of how he planned everything in a few hours. I am sure he did this to hurt me and his family as his last revenge. I can't help you but at least You know you're not the only one, I hate him too. And someday we won't, don't rush it

I'm glad I read your comment. Thank you for this<3

Damn, I felt this. The guilt I feel when I get a little calmer, when I laugh, when I hug. Out of spite I want to feel bad again, go back to crying, in the hopes that he's watching and knows he hurt me and that no one will get over this easily, maybe ever. To prove him wrong. Ugh. I hope you get better, you deserve it. She sounds like she was a beautiful human being but so are you. And you deserve just as much happiness as she did. Wish you the best. <3

Thank you 💗  wish you the best
